conclusions: Human face/fingers and equipment load and remain recognizable through the sampled prepared poses.
Fine skin is clean in Low/Medium/High; equipment/clothing/weapon silhouettes and scoped High stone retain contours.
Near/far red versus blue/teal accents remain distinct; the warm key and golden base paint mute the blue accent.
First-person M4 and Greek Columns use the actual shared painted atlas and existing geometry; close camera framing exposes the inherited box-based M4 form.
Carrier edge protrusions, beveled armor facets and inherited support-hand barrel wrap remain visible aesthetic limits, not a human pass.
limits: Static alias samples do not establish transition/motion shimmer quality; existing real animation regressions cover contracts only.
Training Range is deliberately ambient/dark. Greek shadow is a controlled key-off comparison.
Synchronous SwiftShader timings omit whole-game/network/input workload and qualify no phone/iGPU/Pi/FPS target.
Production lifetime screenshots retain the existing small-DPR fixture size; full-pixel posed/team images are offline actual-game samples.
Inherited rig/motion/animation FBX/weapon FBX terms remain unresolved.
